{{Infobox Gwent Card |name = Kambi |image = Tw3 gwent card face Kambi.png |deck = Skellige |type = Unit |row = {{Gwent close combat}} |strength = 0 |spec_ability = When this card is removed from the battlefield, it summons a powerful [[Hemdall (gwent card)|new Unit Card]] to take its place. |source = Won from [[Hauteville]]'s [[Armorer (Hauteville)|armorer]] |caption = When the time comes, the cockerel Kambi shall crow and awaken Hemdall. |id = gwint_card_cock |icon = Tw3 icon gwent melee skellige.png}}'''Kambi''' is a [[Gwent close combat cards|close combat]] [[gwent]] card in the {{BaW}} and part of the [[Skellige Gwent deck|Skellige deck]]. ==Tips== *The value of this card is debatable, while it does summon the [[Hemdall (gwent card)|Hemdall]] hero card, effectively making it the only hero card that can be used more than once during a game, the problem is that the card may also be revived through the [[Skellige Gwent deck]]s special ability in a 3rd round making it a con rather than a pro then. *You can avoid this by using the [[Crach an Craite (gwent card)]] ability during the 2nd round, however this will prevent you from calling Hemdall a 2nd time for the 3rd round.
